title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI hook and quality gating improvements
author: Priya Sharma
description: Motivation: improve per-prompt regression detection and make quality gating actionable in CI. This PR introduces a per-prompt CI hook that runs a lightweight eval subset, computes prompt-level regressions, and surfaces failures as annotated CI comments. It also adds a configurable quality gating layer that supports: (1) per-prompt thresholds, (2) aggregated quality scores, and (3) configurable severity (warning/required). The change includes a new metrics exporter for eval results, small refactors to the eval harness runner for faster warm-starts, and updates to the GitHub Actions workflow to parallelize prompt shards. Checklist: - [x] implement per-prompt CI hook and runner - [x] add thresholding and severity settings - [x] emit annotated GitHub comments for failing prompts - [x] add metrics exporter integration (prometheus-compatible) - [x] update docs and examples - [x] add unit + integration tests for gating logic Related: ENG-2314 (per-prompt gating), ENG-2378 (eval metrics plumbing). See internal design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/ENG-2314/per-prompt-ci-hook (internal).

review_conversation: Evan Park: Can we make the default threshold conservative to avoid noisy CI failures?
Priya Sharma: Agreed. Default thresholds set to 'warning' level; repo admins can set required for protected branches via .evalrc.
Marco Lee: The parallelization is great - did you verify GPU memory usage on dedicated runners?
Priya Sharma: Yes, added a fast-warm path that keeps model warmed but limits batch size on CI to avoid OOM on smaller runners. Added integration test that simulates 8GB workers.
Samantha Nguyen: The annotated comments are noisy when many prompts fail. Can we collapse them into a summary?
Priya Sharma: Updated to emit a summary comment plus per-prompt collapsible sections; GitHub thread links included for top 5 failing prompts.
Evan Park: Approved after the threshold default change and tests added. (LGTM)
